Name: Drakos
Author: Drakos Team
Description:
A plugin to automate crafting, gathering, and market board functions. Drakos allows you to construct orders and automate gathering, crafting, and undercutting on the market board.

/drakos opens the Drakos window.
/drakos kill stops everything Drakos is doing at once. Reload the plugin to use Drakos again.
/drakos license on signs this character in to Drakos licensing.
/drakos license off gently stops running automation, then signs this character out of Drakos licensing.
